en.title: Attach anything | Modular aluminium profile system
en.description: A nut in the groove of an aluminium profile and a screw: that is how shelves, brackets, hinges or lights are attached. See in 3D how it works.
en.lead: Slide a nut into the groove of the aluminium profile, tighten a screw and the joint is solid. No drilling, no welding.
en.stage: Animated 3D model: attaching parts into the groove of the profile
en.noscript: JavaScript is required for the 3D demo.
en.nowebgl: This browser cannot show 3D (WebGL). Please try another one.

cues.intro: Aluminium profile 30×30: a slot on each of the four sides
cues.slot: The T-slot opening measures 8.2 mm; the nut catches inside the chamber
cues.kamen: The slot nut slides into the groove from the end of the profile
cues.srouby1: The screw pulls the part onto the nut: a firm joint
cues.otocna: Place the twist-in nut anywhere in the groove and turn it 90° behind the slot edges
cues.otocna_otocit: The nut turns 90° and seats behind the slot edges
cues.srouby2: The screw threads into the seated nut and secures the hinge
cues.cokoli: You can attach anything: shelves, brackets, hinges, handles, lights, castors…
cues.spoj_zavit: The end of the new profile has a tapped thread.
cues.spoj_predmontaz: Screw the connecting screw into the end of the new profile.
cues.spoj_mezera: Leave approximately 2.3 mm under the head to slide it into the slot.
cues.spoj_nasunuti: Slide the profile and screw from the slot end to the middle.
cues.spoj_otvor: Open an access hole in the original profile for a long hex bit.
cues.spoj_dotazeni: Tighten the connecting screw through the hole with the long hex bit.
cues.spoj_pevne: Screw connection: the two profiles are firmly joined.

en.other_title: The same principle works for other profiles
en.other_lead: The profiles in our range have a T-slot. Only its width and the nut size change; the procedure is the same: slide in the nut, tighten the screw.
en.other_40_note: The larger profile has a 10 mm slot and uses matching nuts.
en.other_30_note: The profile shown above. The M6 slot nut and twist-in nut fit the 8 mm slot.
